name: Tristan Jessup
headline: Applied AI systems & integration · Senior bench technician, Geek Squad
summary: Most senior bench technician at Geek Squad (Best Buy Store #259), CompTIA A+, Network+ and Security+ certified and an Apple Certified Repair Technician. I design agentic tooling that pairs small language models with scripted tools, and build AI governance experiments where every claim is mapped to a test. Seeking enterprise AI integration, AI solutions and AI architecture roles.

selectedWork.title: MCX: Meta-Concord reference implementation
selectedWork.detail: Python (Apache-2.0) reference implementation of domain-assent authorization for agent actions: Ed25519-signed evidence, a separately written verifier, a fail-closed enforcer, a red-team catalogue, and CLAIMS.md mapping each white-paper claim to a test or marking it not shown.

selectedWork.title: Emergent Divergence
selectedWork.detail: Controlled multi-agent LLM experiment (3 conditions × 2 backends × 4 seeds) with eight falsifiable hypotheses, a decoding-noise null baseline, full run provenance, and a hard cost cap. Pilot results published, including a non-significant trend.

selectedWork.title: Anvil (paused prototype)
